question: How does Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm work?

scenes.sub: Always settle the closest unsettled node. Then relax its roads.
scenes.say: Dijkstra finds the cheapest route from one node to all others, when roads have different costs. Let's watch it run.

scenes.head: Think of a GPS
scenes.say: Think of a GPS. Towns whose best distance is final are called settled. Pick the closest unsettled town. Then relax its roads. Relaxing means asking: is the route to a neighbor cheaper through this town? If yes, update it.

scenes.head: Five towns, roads with travel times

changes.cue: Town three through one costs four
Town three through one costs four

scenes.say: Five towns, roads with travel times. Start at zero. Distance zero is known, everything else is infinity. Relax its roads: town one costs four, town two costs one. The closest unsettled town is two. Relax: through two, town one costs three, better than four, and town three costs six. Closest now is one, at three. Town three through one costs four, better than six. Closest is three. Town four costs seven. Done.

scenes.head: Dijkstra in C plus plus
scenes.say: The code. Distances start at infinity, here the biggest long long. A min heap holds pairs of distance and town. Pop the closest. If its distance is bigger than what we already know, it's stale, so skip it. Otherwise relax every road. A better route updates the distance and pushes a new pair. Time is O of E log V.

scenes.head: In the interview
rows: Dijkstra fails. Use Bellman Ford, O of V times E.
Plain BFS. Weights zero or one: a deque.
O of E log V with a binary heap.
No stale check, or int overflow on sums.
scenes.say: Negative edge weights? Dijkstra fails, use Bellman Ford. Unweighted graph? Plain BFS. Complexity? O of E log V. Common mistake: skipping the stale check, or using int and overflowing on sums.

lines: Dijkstra: always settle the closest unsettled node.
Relax its edges, using a min-heap: O(E log V).
scenes.say: Dijkstra always settles the closest unsettled node, then relaxes its edges using a min heap. It runs in O of E log V, and only works with non-negative weights.
